paper.title: PBench: A Physical AI Benchmark for World Models
paper.data: 1,044 image/prompt samples and 5,636 manually corrected QA pairs across six Physical AI domains
paper.method: ontology-grounded video QA domain score combined with eight VBench quality metrics
paper.task: evaluate physical-domain correctness and visual quality of world-model videos
paper.novelty: pairs physical ontology QA with video quality across AV, robotics, industry, physics, human and commonsense domains
paper.project_relevance: Reusable physical ontology and separate domain/quality scores for embodied world evaluation.

paper.title: WonderWorld: Interactive 3D Scene Generation from a Single Image
paper.data: single images with user camera/content controls across natural and built environments
paper.method: Fast Layered Gaussian Surfels, text outpainting and guided depth diffusion
paper.novelty: low-latency connected 3D scene expansion under online camera and content control
paper.project_relevance: Direct baseline for interactive world building and latency-aware PCG.

paper.title: WonderPlay: Dynamic 3D Scene Generation from a Single Image and Actions
paper.data: single-image action examples spanning rigid, elastic, cloth, smoke, liquid and granular materials
paper.method: Gaussian-surfels reconstruction, material-specific physics solvers, video generation and differentiable 3D state refinement
paper.task: generate action-conditioned dynamic 3D scenes across material types
paper.novelty: closes the loop between explicit coarse multi-material physics and generative video refinement
paper.project_relevance: Executable-world reference for typed materials, forces and hybrid simulated/generated state.

paper.title: ABot-PhysWorld: Interactive World Foundation Model for Robotic Manipulation with Physics Alignment
paper.data: three million physics-annotated manipulation clips plus released SFT data and EZS-Bench
paper.method: 14B diffusion transformer with physics-aware DPO, decoupled discriminators and spatial action context blocks
paper.novelty: decoupled physics/quality preference alignment with cross-embodiment spatial action injection
paper.project_relevance: Open action-to-video world-model and zero-shot physical evaluation baseline.

paper.title: PAIWorld: A 3D-Consistent World Foundation Model for Robotic Manipulation
paper.method: Geometry-Aware Cross-View Attention, camera-aware Geo-RoPE and Latent 3D-REPA on a flow-matching video DiT
paper.task: multi-view future generation for prediction, planning and policy post-training
paper.novelty: joint explicit inter-view communication and geometric representation alignment
paper.project_relevance: Multi-camera world-action baseline with geometry-consistency validation.

paper.title: PAI-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark For Physical AI
paper.data: 2,808 real-world cases across driving, robotics, smart-space and egocentric domains
paper.method: three-task suite for generation, conditional generation and physical video understanding
paper.task: evaluate perception and prediction capabilities of Physical AI models
paper.novelty: unifies generated futures, spatially controlled generation and understanding across physical domains
paper.project_relevance: Umbrella scorecard for generation, conditional generation and understanding.

paper.title: PhysBench: Benchmarking and Enhancing Vision-Language Models for Physical World Understanding
paper.data: 10,002 interleaved image-video-text entries across 19 physical-world subclasses
paper.method: multimodal multiple-choice benchmark plus specialist-tool-augmented PhysAgent
paper.task: evaluate physical properties, relations, scenes and dynamics understanding
paper.novelty: large physical-understanding diagnostic across 75 VLMs with error and scaling analysis
paper.project_relevance: Upstream physical-reasoning gate for executable and action models.
